units.text: Evidence from Wikipedia and Good Good Good shows most sport disciplines at the 2026 Winter Games in Italy were not fully gender balanced. Wikipedia reports 196 competitors (103 men, 93 women) across 16 sports, with sport-by-sport breakdown showing unequal gender representation. Good Good Good states

citations.title: Italy at the 2026 Winter Olympics - Wikipedia

judgement.reason: Good Good Good says 12 of the 16 sports achieved full gender parity, so most disciplines were gender balanced, contradicting the claim; the Wikipedia sport table only shows headers and no data demonstrating unequal representation.

units.text: women comprise 47% of all athletes, 50 women's events, and 12 of 16 sports achieving full gender parity. The claim 'fully gender balanced' is not corroborated; 47% overall participation and parity in 12/16 sports does not equal 'most disciplines fully gender balanced'.

judgement.reason: The 47%, 50 women's events, and 12/16 full parity figures are directly in the passage, but the passage says 'most gender-balanced in history,' not 'fully gender balanced,' so the final evaluative assertion is not directly supported by the quoted text.
